recommendation: Keep the audit as an external-repo decision for core. If validators still report missing resource-information in current packages, follow up in the HL7 Tools Extension IG or HL7/fhir-ig-publisher to define or stop emitting that external tool extension.
issue_request: FHIR-35778 was a Published/Persuasive R4 technical correction reporting that IG Publisher-generated ImplementationGuide resources referenced unknown tool extensions such as ig-parameter and resource-information and used IG Publisher parameter codes outside the R4 guide-parameter-code value set.
initial_application: No core commit explicitly mentioned FHIR-35778. The relevant core-side model change was FHIR-20018 (493ea99d47628ab5c056aed42faff4b36ecdb638), which made ImplementationGuide.definition.parameter.code a Coding and added an extensible binding, with follow-up guide-parameter-code metadata fixes.
additional_context: FHIR-I minutes treated the item as tools-folder / FHIR-Tool-IG work. The current published hl7.fhir.uv.tools package defines StructureDefinition/ig-parameter and CodeSystem/ig-parameters containing the requested parameter codes. Current external package output can still contain resource-information references, so any remaining cleanup belongs in the Tools IG or IG Publisher rather than core.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch. Core's active ImplementationGuide source already provides the generic extensible parameter-code hook; no core file should enumerate IG Publisher-specific internals solely to make generated package output valid.

related_jiras.note: Changed ImplementationGuide.definition.parameter.code to Coding with an extensible guide-parameter-code binding, enabling external tool-specific code systems.
Later clinical reasoning page update copied a CPG ImplementationGuide fragment using resource-information; that page does not make core the owner of the tool extension.
Related tooling/package discussion found during Zulip review, not decided because it requires a separate issue investigation.
